# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Four Winds, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Politician and community member

## Appearance

For many years, Marshall Elliott possessed an extraordinarily long beard and wild, uncut hair, giving him a striking and eccentric appearance. After shaving his beard and cutting his hair, he was revealed to be a handsome, fine-looking man.

## Personality

Marshall is a man of fierce conviction, immense stubbornness, and deep political loyalty. Despite his eccentric vow, he is genial, kind-hearted, and well-liked by his neighbors in Four Winds. He possesses a dramatic sense of honor and patience in romance.

## Traits

- Stubborn
- Politically zealous
- Loyal
- Good-natured

## Abilities

- Political campaigning

## Goals

- To see the Liberal party win a government election
- To marry Miss Cornelia Bryant

## History

Marshall Elliott is a long-time resident of Four Winds who made a famous political vow in his youth never to shave or cut his hair until the Liberals won the election. Because the Conservatives remained in power for decades, Marshall's hair and beard grew to extraordinary lengths, making him one of the coastline's notable eccentrics. He held a long-standing affection for Miss Cornelia Bryant, but she refused to marry a man who looked like a tramp. When the Liberals finally won a general election, Marshall promptly went to the barber, cut his hair, shaved his beard, and bought a new suit of clothes. Transformed back into a handsome, respectable man, he immediately proposed to Miss Cornelia Bryant. She accepted him, and the two were happily married, settling down together in Four Winds.

## Background by volume

- Made a vow in his youth not to cut his hair or shave his beard until the Grit (Liberal) party came into power.
- Endured decades of his party being out of office, maintaining his vow despite public amusement and courtships stalled.

## Affiliations

- Liberal Party (Grits) — Staunch supporter and campaigner
